independent mathematical check.meaning: The accepted repeated-direction reduction and F2 bridge remain valid. The UNKNOWN runs do not decide feasibility, and the 12-violation distinct support is not a decomposition. These conclusions do not settle the characteristic-zero BILR/Jennrich route.

remaining_scientific_state: The finite-field route is now concentrated on the distinct projected-A E11-core branch. A complete-Wang admissible distinct support would trigger exact fixed-A B/C completion and residual lift testing; a proof-producing distinct-support exclusion would yield R_F2(T)>=21 together with the existing no-rank-one certificates. No rank<=22 algorithm, no R_F2>=21 theorem, and no characteristic-zero rank-23 optimality proof has been obtained.
